result:
QA-79963 is a PASS: Brand > Content Video post counts for MTV on Viacom match the Time Window Comparison (TWC) report on every channel.

| Metric | Content | TWC |
|---|---|---|
| Facebook (Reel excluded) | 5 | 5 |
| Twitter | 9 | 9 |
| Instagram | 7 | 7 |
| TikTok | 12 | 12 |
| YouTube | channel not available for MTV | 0 |
| All channels | 33 | 33 |

- **Setup:** Both sides used Oct 12–18, 2026 with Authorized data, and the TWC interval was Aggregate. TWC was built once with all six metrics instead of once per channel.
- **YouTube:** The YouTube icon is greyed out for MTV in both Authorized and Public views, so that leg is "no data on either side". It may be worth confirming with LFIQA that MTV is supposed to have no YouTube feed.
- **Spec drift:** The Reporting menu has no "Classic reporting" item, so I opened Time Window Comparison directly from it.
- **Known bugs:** None open, and none reproduced. The Facebook insights-disruption banner on the page did not affect the post counts.

Per the run instructions, skill and registry maintenance is left to `harvest.sh`.

The report is at `results/2026-10-20/QA-79963-report.md`, and screenshots are under `.playwright-out/QA-79963/`.
